probe: F — per-team gradient geometry (PCGrad substrate test)

state_construction.source: the five R2 fork runs' own eval_traces (both recorded steps); each fork's --trainee-teams pins exactly the two slice teams its traces contain

distill.definition: masked mean of -log pi_S(a_teacher) over the legal set; a_teacher = the team's slice teacher's argmax
deviations: the AWR row weight w = clamp(exp(|A_hat|/beta), 20) is dropped (A_hat is not recoverable offline) -> every row carries w = 1
eccfe630ec08de27 is pinned by BOTH F5a and F5e and the live fold averages the two teachers' KLs; this probe uses F5a only, per the mission

bc.definition: masked mean of -log pi_S(a_recorded) — the policy gradient with every advantage set to +1

pgmc.definition: -(A_hat * log pi_S(a_recorded)).mean() with A_hat = per-batch-standardized (R - V_rec(s)), R = +1 win / -1 loss / 0 tie
pgmc.status: PARTIALLY RESOLVED — 2 of 9 teams fail the cross-half positivity test

pg.definition: -(A_hat * log pi_S(a_recorded)).mean() with A_hat = per-batch-standardized within-battle TD residual of the recorded critic
pg.status: UNRESOLVED — the estimator returns |cos| > 1 (up to 27.8 in policy_head), i.e. the batch noise exceeds the signal; reported, never interpreted

method.noise_ceiling: cosine between two BATTLE-DISJOINT batches of the SAME team — the number every between-team cosine must be read against
method.noise_free_estimator: cross-half Gram: <mean(folds 0,2,4), mean(folds 1,3,5)> is unbiased for <mu_i, mu_j> including i==j, because the two halves' batch noises are independent
method.uncertainty: all 10 balanced 3/3 fold splits; a pair counts as CONFLICTING only if it is negative in every split
method.missing_policy: a team whose own cross-half inner product is <= 0 has NO resolvable team-consistent gradient at this sample size; every cosine involving it is MISSING, never imputed as zero. A group a loss cannot reach at all is labelled structurally_zero instead.
method.pcgrad_arithmetic: PCGrad projects g_i off each conflicting g_j, removing ||g_i||*|cos_ij| of NORM and |cos_ij|^2 of ENERGY; the per-team sum over conflicting j is an UPPER BOUND because the sequential projections interfere
method.isotropic_null: PC1 energy fraction for 9 mutually orthogonal team gradients = 1/9 = 0.1111
